notes.title: The Psions has gone live
notes.content:
Hello Psions,

We are excited to announce the retro overhaul of Hope’s End - The Psions - has arrived! If you previously purchased Hope’s End the DLC for the Psions should have automatically unlocked for you. New Psions will have access to all Ascendencies each in Frost and Electric. The Psions DLC is available to purchase for $3.99 to unlock the other specializations.

Thank you for supporting us through the evolution of Hope’s End: Arcade! If you have any questions, or concerns or need help with the DLC conversion please reach out to us. We hope to have more to share with you about our next game in the catalog: “The Captains” in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Hope's End Overhaul Beta Launch
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Psions![/b]

We wanted to take a moment to update you on the exciting launch of the Beta overhauled Hope's End. We released the game in Early Access to gather valuable feedback and make substantial improvements based on your input. And boy, did we receive some incredible feedback from our passionate community! We want to express our sincere gratitude for your support and enthusiasm throughout this journey.

Over the course of the past few weeks in Early Access, we realized that we were trying to be too many things to too many people, losing sight of the original vision we had for Hope's End. For us, Hope's End has always been about creating a modern yet nostalgic arcade-style Roguelike game, a true gem reminiscent of the classic coin-op experiences. Whether you're looking for a quick 20-minute solo session or an immersive 5-hour marathon with friends on Discord, we aimed to deliver a rewarding experience that captures the essence of those beloved arcade days.

We admit that we missed the mark with the first version, but we were determined to recapture the core essence we fell in love with. We added too many systems and got carried away with progression and unlocks that lost sight of the Roguelike arcade-style soul of the game. So, we took a step back, gathered all the valuable feedback you provided, and set out to make significant improvements. We are thrilled to announce that the results have exceeded our expectations!

The overhauled version of Hope's End not only delivers the gameplay experience we always envisioned, but it also embraces a retro vibe in its overall style. We understand that this aesthetic might be a "love it or hate it" affair, but it allows Hope's End to establish a unique and unmistakable character of its own. We've poured our hearts into this reimagined version, ensuring that Hope’s End is the experience we always wanted to give to you, our players.

We are fully aware that this overhaul represents a massive change for those who have already purchased the game. However, your satisfaction and enjoyment are of utmost importance to us. That's why we've created a public beta branch, allowing everyone who owns the game to experience it and provide us with valuable feedback. Your insights and opinions will be crucial in shaping the final version.

Stay tuned for more updates and announcements as we progress towards the official release. Good luck, Psions! Let's embark on this thrilling adventure together and make Hope's End shine brighter than ever before!

[Beta Access Instructions]
To access the Beta on Steam right click on Hope’s End in your library and click Properties -> Betas and choose the Beta branch there. 

Best regards,
The Explorers Guild

notes.title: Major update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello, Psions!

We want to update the community regarding our first major update after the Early Access launch. We received a lot of great feedback from the community during the first couple of weeks of Early Access and the alpha before that and those experiences helped us realize that we didn’t hit the mark we were aiming for with this first version of Hope’s End.

As the systems of Hope’s End started layering together things felt good.  We wanted to add depth to the game for everyone to explore: More progression, more unlocks, more difficulty sliders, more everything. But as we packed features into the game we veered away from our vision of the quick, bit-sized, retro arcade-style gameplay we’d originally set out to create. With a team our size simplicity is extremely important, we let feature creep pull our attention away from the key aspects that would make Hope’s End a unique Explorers Guild game. The good news is that all of you helped us catch it early and are working fast and hard to remedy the situation. 

We will be releasing a beta version of this update in a week or two and we are eager to hear all of your feedback. We are not detailing out all of the changes because frankly there are just too many. It is a dramatically different game and you will notice that from the moment you log in. One of the first things you will likely notice is the far more unique retro visual style we have for the game. We realize that we were far too cautious with the visuals of Hope’s End and didn’t like our vision of what a psionic god-like projection view of the world would look like. 

We will update the roadmap after this new version is released. We are designing the game to be played in Seasons, much like Path of Exile or Diablo 3, and this new update will set us up well for Season 1. We are excited to see you all in the new and simplified world of Hope’s End soon! 

We will be posting more updates, videos, streams, and images in the coming days on our [url=https://discord.gg/fnvwJ2MJeC]Discord[/url].

notes.title: v0.6.6042 Patch note - 4/24/2023
notes.content:
[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where you could lose your save file if you logged into steam on a different computer with the same account
[*] Fixed some FPS issues with Stormcaller, still more to fix here but should be much better
[/list]

[b][u]UI Updates[/u][/b]
We have made changes across most of the UI to streamline things and reduce overall clutter. The most significant updates are the Armory screen and In-Game UI.

[b][u]Armory and Late Game Scaling[/u][/b]
Armory kill passive upgrades were scaling much faster than intended when combined with Psion Rank. We have made a few adjustments to make sure that you can still make significant progress increasing your power, but not become so powerful you don't even need to play the game.

To compensate for this shift in power, all Armory Passive (the ones that scaled with kills) no longer require a minimal kill count to activate.

[list]
[*] Total kills are now capped at 1,000,000 for the generic (left side) unlocks
[*] Specialization specific kills are capped at 500,000
[*] Psion Rank 1 gives you double kills but this does not increase after rank 1. The other stats still increase with each rank.
[/list]

[b][u]Val[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a volume control slider in settings to control the volume of Val. She will still show up but you can silence her or quite her.
[*] You can click Val when she appears to dismiss that message and stop her immediately 
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Day Hotfix
notes.content:
There were a few significant bugs that players reported that we wanted to hotfix as quickly as possible. A few others are still being worked on. We will have other updates in a regular patch later. 

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Black Blossoms and Eyeless were not properly scaling with game length.[/b] They are now much tougher enemies (as they always were supposed to be). 
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Mortar turret damage fixed. [/b]The biggest impact is on late game scaling. Turrets are meant to supplement your ability damage and effects, not solo the game for you.
[/list]

[u]Known Issues:[/u]
[list]
[*] FPS can drop on Stormcaller with a lot of enemies alive at once. We are investigating this. (It is possible that this can also happen on Electric but it is not confirmed)
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access is Live!
notes.content:
[b]We are thrilled to announce that Hope's End is now officially live in Early Access on Steam![/b]

This is just the start of the journey and we have tons of content we are still working on adding to the game, more details below on that. With this initial release into EA we are hoping to get as much player feedback as possible to make the game great. 

As a team we have a passion for single player games that let you just pick up and play for 20 minutes or 3 hours. We have played our fair share of games with weekly resets and hardcore PVP and they are great, but they aren't the thing that captures our hearts. With Hope's End we are hoping that we capture that feeling of deep progression and skill cap to unlock and chase but balanced with the feeling that it is a game you can pick up AND put down whenever you want without pressure to keep up with everyone else.

Now that EA release is out, please join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/fnvwJ2MJeC]Discord[/url], and give us your feedback. We have a vision for where the game is going, but a major part of that vision is how the community engages with it. As a 3 person team we count on our players to help us see new ideas and ways to improve existing features. This has already been happening with our awesome Beta testers and the game is completely different then it would have been without them.

[h1]Now about that roadmap....[/h1]

First, we have disabled leaderboards for the time being. We didn't have a chance to properly encrypt and secure the save file so we didn't want to encourage shenanigans with hacked high scores out of the gate. We absolutely think that playing the game without hacking your save file is the best experience, but it is a single player game and you can do what you want (don't blame us if you break stuff). But you can see how they can conflict with public leaderboards. Anyways, this is something we will continue to kick around with the community.

[h2]Stormcaller Specialization[/h2]
We were able to fit this into the Early Access build and it is playable now. The first of our second set of 6 Specializations (12 total).

[h2]The Matriarchs & our next Specialization[/h2]
The Matriarchs update will introduce the leaders of the Blighted as boss encounters during a game. Some of them will be spawned with specific triggers that you can control, others will be a bit harder to manage when they show up. When they do show up you will need to focus your attention on bringing them down before they bring complete destruction to the valley and Hope's End. Each will have it's own special mechanics that you will have to learn and deal with. 

We will have more details on the next Specialization in the coming weeks.

[h2]Val Upgrades [/h2]
We fully expect Val to be a character that is both loved and loathed. For us she is the result of countless hours hanging out with Claptrap and GLaDOS and a key part to making Hope's End come alive. The Val update will make her more than just a voice in your head, she will actively be "helping" you in combat. She may malfunction from time to time and be less helpful they she would hope, but with a few upgrades and tweaks we are sure you can make her "useful" and possibly even adjust her sarcasm settings.

[h2]Steam Achievements [/h2]
Yes there will be many Steam Achievements! We will likely add these rather soon, we just wanted things to settle down a bit in the development cycle first so they can be stable and things we keep. 

[h2]New Maps [/h2]
We have a lot of ideas bouncing around for where we go next with maps in Hope's End. This is a topic we will be discussing more with the community on Discord so please join in. The 1.0 release of Hope's End will have multiple maps and mission goals, that much we know for sure. 

Thanks again for giving Hope's End a try and we look forward to seeing your high scores!

notes.title: Tales From The Wastelands - The Seed of Understanding
notes.content:
[i]"You will still die, you know."[/i]

The voice shot through me like a bolt, at once inside my mind yet still discernible from without. More than one sense responded to the will it sent to me - telepathy, but on an order of magnitude I'd never experienced before. My arm froze but my eyes darted about the area, seeking the psion at its source.

[i]"You search for treasures to buy you time. Things to exchange for meager resources to sustain your life. I have already seen it. It will make no difference."[/i]

I scanned along the mountainside. There had to be something nearby - the glint of metal; any color that stood out. I was standing beside the only wreckage in the vicinity. There were plenty of places they could be hiding, but there should be [i]some [/i]tell if they were actively watching me. Then I caught sight of it, staggering backward as realization dawned on me. I’d been looking for something small, but the gleam of light I finally saw was off of a surface the size of a goddamn building. The eye blinked at me.

[i]"Yes, you do seem to have located me. Very good. Now as I was saying, there is no point."[/i]

All scavengers carry at least some equipment to defend themselves in the event of an attack from Blighted...or scavengers from a competing settlement. This, though - this was beyond the help of any gear portable enough for a lone scavenger to even humor the thought of fighting. I was half-collapsed beneath the largest Blighted I'd ever seen in-person. Thoughts fought within my mind, devouring each other in a rapid struggle for dominance. [i]Stand. Hide. Run. Fight. [/i]

"What the hell difference does it make to you, you freak?!"

It probably says more about me than I care to admit that my response wasn't anything typically useful for survival. I didn't care. I was exhausted from the trip up the mountainside. I was half-starving from months of meager rations. My parents had died in an attack decades ago; I had no surviving attachments. To be told I would die - not killed but politely informed, by this...monstrosity. It was more than my heart could bear.

[i]"Your struggle intrigued me. Part of you also understands this is futile, yet your actions speak of continuing to fight."
[/i]
"What, you think we're just going to lie down and die? You don't understand a damn thing about us."

[i]"Lie down and die...? No. Our power is strong. Our numbers are overwhelming. Our strategies are effective. Choosing another action would be the wisest action. You have built a bastion for yourselves and chosen to directly defy us. You could have fled. You could have hid. You could have aggressively struck back in a direct assault. Like your resistance, these would all have likely led to your doom, but I can envision some chance of success. Some chance of survival."[/i]

"We're still alive now, aren't we?!"

[i]"And our next wave will soon be arriving to change that."[/i]

"And that's going to end us? Like the last? Hope's End is still standing. It was standing when I left. It'll be standing after I'm dead. Which might not be very far in the future, I admit. But it's more than just any physical bastion. It's our will. We've chosen to live. Try anything you bastards like. You're never going to break us. Not our heart, not our spirit."

I was a dead man. That was the only sane price for the show of the defiance I'd made. With nothing left to lose, I could at least stand up for us by proxy. I thought back to all the times I'd scorned bookkeepers at the colony. The times I'd spent hungry or alone. The times I'd doubted or despaired over decisions made by leaders. Yeah, things were awful - but we were still [i]together[/i]. They were worth standing up for. I knew they'd do the same, even for a scavenger like me.

I wasn't ready for the Blighted's response, though.

[i]"Let us test this theory, then."
[/i]
The arch above me moved. I'd mistaken it for stone while it was standing still, but it shifted with such a smoothness that there was no chance I could try to put any distance between us now. It was eerie, how slick its flesh seemed. I'd heard of Black Blossoms before - powerful Blighted psions that could shatter entire mountains with their minds. I’d had no idea they could grow so large, though. Seeing this one in person damn near knocked me out from awe alone.

As the motion slowed, I realized that what I’d believed was a shift to crush me seemed to just be an adjustment of posture. I’d almost passed out from the Black Blossom’s equivalent to leaning back in a chair to get more comfortable.

[i]"Return to your bastion. We gather for an attack now as we never have before. Inform your leaders, if you like. Bolster your defenses. Let us see, then, how much the mettle of humanity truly matters. And if you are alive when the dust has settled, I would like it if you returned. If your ideals hold weight, I would be interested in speaking with you again."[/i]

That last impression carried a psionic weight to it, and I felt something press into my mind. Like that, I finally found my legs again. I bolted to my feet and started to sprint as fast as my body would carry me. When I finally summoned the courage to look back, there was nothing there. Maybe I lost sight of it among the mountain side. Maybe it was a hallucination brought on by lack of nourishment. 

The thought of food alone was enough to shake me further back to reality - I’d failed to pull any resources of significance this trip, too, and that meant I’d be back on meager rations if I was [i]lucky[/i]. Maybe, though, what I’d been told actually would be of some value. Maybe I could trade it for food. Something told me that Commander Shaw wouldn’t value such a wild account very highly, but stranger things had happened in the wastelands. Whether I’d be believed or not, a feeling of discomfort took root at the pit of my stomach and didn’t go away the entire journey back.

[i]-Account as told by Azran Finch, Wasteland Scavenger of Hope’s End of an encounter with The Observer[/i]

notes.title: Hope's End is coming to Early Access!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Psions![/h3]

To those of you who have assisted with testing through our alpha process, we offer you our heartfelt thanks for the bugs quashed and insight provided. Your assistance has been invaluable in getting Hope's End to the state it's in today.

For everyone joining us fresh - welcome! Hope's End will soon be entering Early Access, and we invite you to join us in anticipation for the arrival of the waves of Blighted. With 6 unique Psionic Specializations, will you be prepared to take up the mantle of Supreme Psion and join the fight for humanity's survival?

The Blighted horde arrives March 16th. Wishlist now, and brace for the onslaught!
